title: Lighting Crew Practice — Area and Security Lighting Rental on the Reconnection Trip for Electric Service by Rate Schedule
content:
**Practice.** Where an Area and Security Lighting Rental light is rented on an Electric Service by Rate Schedule account that is being reconnected after a nonpayment disconnection, the crew attends to the light on the reconnection trip, and the reconnection adds an area light restoration charge to the reconnect fee. The rental's status and its additional pole count are read from the lighting rental record of the same service account.

| Area light rented on the account | What the crew does | Added to the reconnect fee |
|---|---|---|
| Out of service | Relamps the light on the reconnection trip | $15.00 |
| Active, standing on one or more additional poles | Checks the poles | $7.50 |
| Active with no additional pole, any other status, or no light rented | — | Nothing |

The charge is added to the crew charge in the reconnect fee, and the total is rounded to the cent.

### Hypothetical cases

| Lighting rental record | Charge |
|---|---|
| LED 70W Area Light, status out of service | $15.00 |
| LED 40W Security Light, active, 2 additional poles | $7.50 |
| HPS 100W Security Light, active, no additional pole | Nothing |
